forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {仕上|しあ}げていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To bring work to its final stage, adding final touches or completing the last steps.

definitions.gloss: to finish off, to put the finishing touches on
definitions.explanation: To complete something by doing the final work that makes it ready.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕上|しあ}げた。
レポート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仕上|しあ}げなければならない。
examples.english: I have to finish the report by the end of today.

examples.notes: [Note: {仕上|しあ}がる is the intransitive form meaning 'to be finished']

examples.english: Furniture finished by hand one piece at a time by a craftsman has a warm feel to it.

notes:
{仕上|しあ}げる is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to finish or complete.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {仕|し} (doing) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise, to complete) → to complete the work

TRANSITIVITY:
- {仕上|しあ}げる (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧): to finish (something)
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧ (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧): to be finished, to turn out

ASPECT (ている):
{仕上|しあ}げている indicates an ongoing process of finishing work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕上|しあ}げる (finish a work)
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仕上|しあ}げる (finish nicely)
- ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仕上|しあ}げる (finish perfectly)
- {仕上|しあ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧ (final stage)

RELATED NOUN:
- {仕上|しあ}げ: finishing, final touches; {仕上|しあ}げ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ = finishing work
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧: finish, result (how something turns out)
